* {{ill|Shiraō Shrine (Nishitosa Egawa, Shimanto)|ja|白皇神社 (四万十市西土佐江川)}} - Located in Nishitosa Egawa, Shimanto City, Kōchi Prefecture.

* {{ill|Shiraō Shrine (Miyauchi, Shimanto Town)|ja|白皇神社 (四万十町宮内)}} - Located in Miyauchi, Shimanto Town, Takaoka District, Kōchi Prefecture.
* Shiraō Shrine (Tosa-Shimizu City) - Formerly located at the summit of Mount Shiraō (白皇山), Tosa-Shimizu City, Kōchi Prefecture ⇒ {{ill|Hakusan Shrine|ja|白山神社 (土佐清水市)|qid=Q11579593}}.
